name_en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
benefit: Life insurance of Rs 2,00,000. If you die from any cause, your family gets Rs 2,00,000. You pay Rs 436 a year, taken from your bank or post office account. If you join for the first time, death other than by accident in the first 30 days is not covered.

other: You must have a savings account in a bank or post office that takes part.
You can join through one account only.

how_to_apply: Fill the form at your bank or post office and agree to auto-debit of the yearly premium. The cover runs from 1 June to 31 May. If you join late, you pay a smaller amount for the rest of the year.

evidence.quote: Rs.2 lakh is payable on member’s death due to any cause.
Premium: Rs.436/- per annum per member.
